answer: The scarce resource is a legal cargo berth. An agent may hold only one lease on a working commercial wharf, recorded in the harbor commission's public atlas with a refundable dockage bond. Each month the harbormaster attests occupancy by signing shore-power meter readings and crane-lift logs; a hollow lease with no power draw and no lifts is cancelled and the bond taken. Forging many identities means paying many full berth rents and bonds, because two keys cannot share a slip and idle waterfront still bills at the commercial rate.
